title: Brain scoring API v1 — the data-plane-clean contract (SERVED)
description: Chunk vectors + structural features + graph metadata in, quantized keep/cut scores out (DIRECTION.md §4, CLAUDE.md non-negotiable). Raw text is unrepresentable by construction: every string field is a const/enum, a fixed-length hex id, or a bounded [A-Za-z0-9:._-] identifier (conv_id, tool name — harness identifiers, never user code); free text has no slot, and the served pydantic models additionally reject unknown fields (extra='forbid'). Served since brain-api/v1 landed in packages/brain: POST /v1/score/trace and /v1/score/tools dispatch on the request `contract` field — 'brain-api-dev/v0' bodies take the dev raw-text path (brain-api-dev.schema.json, our machines only), 'brain-api/v1' bodies take this one. The client featurizes where the text lives: local embedder (bge-large-compatible, 1024-d), node_struct_with_type(21) per chunk, the 49-col readout struct per decided row, and the rel-4 supersession pairs (the only text-dependent edge relation). The server rebuilds the exact trained graph topology from ids alone (graph-construction.md §1-2) — verified score-identical to the dev path by the cross-path parity gate (packages/brain/tests/test_v1.py). Scores ride the 1e-6 fixed-point grid (engine SCORE_SCALE).

grid_q.description: fixed-point score on the 1e-6 grid (engine SCORE_SCALE): q = round(sigmoid * 1_000_000)

checkpoint_id.description: sha256 of the checkpoint .pt the client featurized against; the brain 409s on mismatch with its loaded bundle (§8.2 matched-pair trap: features and weights must move together)

ident.description: bounded identifier charset — no free text representable

hex16_id.description: salted 16-hex identity hash — equality/truthiness ride the wire, never the string it names; irreversible server-side (the salt stays on the client)

vec1024.description: L2-normalized bge-large-compatible embedding (fp32 values; the server casts to fp32 exactly as the dev path casts its embedder output)

node.description: one live chunk, featurized client-side. The graph rebuilt server-side depends on: emb_text (xe content slot + rel-2 kNN cosine), emb_cmd/emb_head (xe slots + command/head hub payloads), struct+markers (xs cols 0-22; the head marker is head_id presence), step (temporal order, step spine, PE), kind (reasoning marker), file_id+lo (rel-0 same-file line-neighbor chain, keyed on id equality + lo ordering; also the file hub and the rel-2 cross-file exclusion), cmd_id (one command hub per distinct (step, cmd_id)), head_id (head hub gate on the command's first chunk).

emb_cmd.description: embedding of the producing command; zero vector when the chunk has none (cmd_id null)

emb_head.description: embedding of the observation head[:240]; zero vector when none (head_id null)

struct.description: node_struct_with_type row: struct_features_causal(16) + struct_type_features(5), computed client-side where the text lives

tokens.description: chunk token weight (max(1, len(text)//4)) — capture/diagnostics parity with the chunk contract; the trace forward reads token mass from `struct`, not from this field

file_id.description: salted hash of the file basename; null = fileless chunk (no rel-0 chain edge, no file hub — the dev path's empty-basename semantics)

lo.description: first original-file line covered; null disables the rel-0 chain for this chunk (whole-file reads, greps, reasoning)

cmd_id.description: salted hash of the producing command string; null = no command (no command hub row)

head_id.description: salted hash of the observation head[:240]; PRESENCE is the has-head marker and gates the head hub on the command's first chunk

name.description: tool name — rides in the clear DELIBERATELY: it is a harness identifier (the keep-set filter's join key back to the request roster), not user code/text

emb.description: embedding of the serialized schema text json.dumps({name, description, parameters}, sort_keys)

tokens.description: len(serialized schema)//4 — the mass unit prune() ranks on; echoed back aligned with scores_q

score_trace_request.description: POST /v1/score/trace with contract='brain-api/v1'. The server rebuilds the trained het graph from the payload (vendored edges/attach_steps/attach_hetero over id stand-ins; HUBPROPS off), runs score_decided over the mask rows with the client's decided_struct, and returns raw-sigmoid scores quantized — bit-identical to the dev path on the same conversation (the test_v1.py parity gate).

target_cov.description: accepted for provenance; tau resolves at bundle load (DASEIN_TARGET_COV), not per request

nodes.description: the LIVE chunk set (client registries applied) in decision order: the stable step-sorted parse order the dev path re-derives — the temporal chain i->i+1 and all equal-step tie-breaks key on this ordering

task_emb.description: embedding of the task statement text[:2000] (the first user message); zeros when absent

sys_emb.description: embedding of the system prompt text[:2000] (the harness hub payload); omitted = zeros

mask.description: rows of `nodes` to decide (undecided newborns); all other rows return exactly 1000000 (never cut)

decided_struct.description: one 49-col readout row per mask entry (graph-construction.md §1.3), computed client-side where the text lives; width is validated against the bundle's read_struct (422 on drift)

edges_supersession.description: client-computed rel-4 pairs [old_src, new_dst] over `nodes` rows — the ONLY text-dependent edge relation (same-file line overlap OR >=0.6 span-set Jaccard, vendored pyg_model.edges semantics). The server sorts pairs lexicographically = the vendored emission order (i asc, j asc), keeping the edge order — and therefore the scatter summation order — bit-identical to the dev path. Required, even when empty: the client must compute it consciously, never default it away.

scores_q.description: one per node row; rows outside mask are exactly 1000000 (never cut)

tau_q.description: the checkpoint's calibrated tau for the serving target_cov — constant per (ckpt, cov)

embed.description: always 0.0 on v1 — the server embeds nothing (structural)

score_tools_request.description: POST /v1/score/tools with contract='brain-api/v1'. Schema nodes attach as task-conditioned causal SINKS (rel 3, task->schema only — never a call->schema edge), exactly the trained attach_tools topology; xe rides the dev path's fp16 round-trip for bit-parity. `nodes` is the tool-spec chunk pipeline view (steps_of pairing; at step 0, mirror the dev fallback of chunking the task text — nodes must be non-empty). No edges_supersession here: rel-4 edges target observation rows only, provably outside the tool rows' receptive field (pinned by the parity gate).

tools.description: the deduped (last-wins) roster in order; [] returns the fail-open shape (names: []) = serve the full roster

names.description: echoes the request roster names, aligned with scores_q/tokens; [] = ineligible, serve full roster (fail-open)

tokens.description: echoes the request token masses (the prune ranking unit)
